actual_boundaries.authority: Real temporary IdeaLake queued task. Actual OrzePhaseMixin._launch_training performs claim, CLAIMED transition, latest task config materialization and ordinary admission. The controller thread owns a separate actual open_existing_lake connection; the observing thread uses its original connection.
actual_boundaries.workload: Tiny standalone CPU script writes only synthetic fixture bytes. Training-launch and provider/fixer are explicit terminal spies; no training, model, GPU allocation, paid provider or network work runs.
actual_boundaries.permitted_doubles: GPU availability reports zero and optional extensions are disabled. Fixer boundary records entry and returns False; training boundary records entry and returns a slot placeholder. No lifecycle, claim, compute writer, reset function or process-tree proof is mocked.
actual_boundaries.observers: Real _reset_idea_for_retry, _write_failure, record_zero_gpu_outcome and actual legacy reaper use transparent wrappers that always invoke their originals and record whether the authenticated writer was alive.
actual_boundaries.worker_ownership: Private AF_UNIX SO_PEERCRED supplies peer PID/UID; pidfd_open occurs before private L releases leader progress. The child setsid/double-forks/execves empty environment, closes stdout/stderr and retains the actual output FD. Tests verify inode, empty inherited ORZE keys, live pidfd and later writes.
actual_boundaries.cleanup: Every root Popen is immediately pidfd-captured. The real prepare_supervised seam captures the actual worker at READY if used; the old implementation ignores that seam. Signals in fixture cleanup target captured own pidfds only. Own temporary subreaper state is restored; no fixture host scan or group-based cleanup.
actual_boundaries.cpu_only_controls: Normal zero exit reaches training spy with no compute start/terminal receipt; normal exit seven takes real failed-admission reporting with zero allocated GPU seconds. Both explicitly verify worker GPU visibility is empty.
actual_boundaries.unknown_future_path: The timeout regression accepts a typed TerminationUnconfirmed HOLD only with no failure count/admission terminal; it also allows confirmed cleanup followed by ordinary failed-admission handling, but never while the writer is live.

limits: These tests are not real research, scientific qualification, model training or artifact-provenance evidence.
Standalone/no-Lake setup, artifact preflight, fixer subprocess ownership and other action phases remain outside this group.
No missing-new-API errors or fixture failures were counted as baseline reds.
The author was notified only after full snapshots and first actual behavior red run were retained.
The independent final result is the nine-test, 18-file hash-matched bounded run above. Root's full-suite/new-contract runs are separate and must not be added to this count.

doc_review.conclusion: The described boundary matches the inspected invocation/claim binding, CPU-only execution, READY/GO/closure, native confirmed-failure reporting and explicit-repair policy. It explicitly excludes script/output immutability, scientific qualification, artifact preflight, adoption and the broader CPU research loop. File effects from partial reporting can remain under HOLD; such files do not prove an accepted SQL/report action.

candidate_integration_failure.classification: New reporter-integration draft defect, not recurrence of the original unsupervised-tree defect and not a fixture failure. The real zero-exit/closure path already passed.
candidate_integration_failure.symptoms: Normal exit seven and the timeout failure path raised AttemptEffectInDoubt after writing the zero-allocation admission receipt. SQL reporting and counters did not finish.
candidate_integration_failure.cause: The reporter's final _source call invokes _cached and an all-history _scan without identifying its own legitimate PREPARED report action. The scanner rejects that unconfirmed entry, rolls back SQL and retains effect HOLD.

diagnostic.method: A read-only pytest report hook prints the already-captured controller exception chain. The frozen test and product functions were not changed.

candidate_integration_failure.snapshot_provenance: Complete then-current files captured with apply_patch immediately after the failed run and before the fix; snapshot hashes matched the run's recorded source hashes. This candidate-specific snapshot group is not the committed historical baseline.
candidate_integration_failure.fix_review: Reporter passes only the current owning transaction's prepared_ref and prepared_sha256 to the scanner's existing exact-pending exception. The source's own complete effect/identity remains validated; unrelated pending history is not ignored.
candidate_integration_failure.draft_snapshot_replay: Not separately executed. The original first run and its diagnostic rerun are retained; committed-baseline whole-module replays are recorded separately.

new_mechanisms.classification: Five independent acceptance mechanisms first green in the nine-test command below. They are not old behavior/API-absence reds.
cases: Runtime refusal after actual READY: no marker/GO, actual owned STOP, confirmed stop receipt, RUNNING HOLD.
Actual stop sentinel created after READY: the unchanged launch guard refuses GO and closes the owned worker, without failure/reset/admission publication.
Real timeout STOP with SIGTERM-handler exit zero and escaped writer: retains actual return code zero but never success; closed failed reporting occurs once without fixer/reset or GPU start.
Actual supervisor killed using its captured own pidfd: RUNNING HOLD, live writer retained until test cleanup, no second STOP, no fresh Popen on retry, no fixer/reset/zero receipt.
Actual prepared READY handle exists but a transparent handoff wrapper raises SupervisionUncertain before returning it: LAUNCHING remains, no GO/NOT_STARTED/replay/automatic STOP.
new_mechanisms.fixture_integrity: Imports and reuses the frozen original CPU fixture; that file and earlier shared fixtures were not edited. Every new process remains real. Faults target policy, a private owned supervisor, or the actual READY return boundary, not invented tree-closure results.
new_mechanisms.process_cleanup: All five completed cleanup using already captured own worker/supervisor/daemon pidfds. No host process discovery or external workload was added.
